privacy.title: JackPote Application Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: The JackPote application, developed by JackPote, attaches great importance to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy aims to inform you clearly and transparently about how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.

data_collection.title: 1. Data We Collect
data_collection.content: We collect the following information when you use our application:
data_collection.additional_info: This information is provided directly by you during registration or when using certain features of the application.

data_use.title: 2. Data Usage
data_use.content: The collected data is used for the following purposes:
details: Creating and managing your user account
Communicating with you (notifications, customer support, etc.)
Analyzing user behavior to optimize the application

data_sharing.title: 3. Data Sharing
data_sharing.content: We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties. However, we may share certain data with trusted third-party services used in the application:
details: Google Analytics: to analyze application usage
Firebase: for authentication, database, and push notifications
Crashlytics: for bug tracking and application stability
data_sharing.additional_info: These services may store data outside the European Union and are subject to their own privacy policies.

data_security.title: 4. Data Security
data_security.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, modification, disclosure, or destruction.

data_retention.title: 5. Data Retention
data_retention.content: Your personal data is retained for as long as necessary for the purposes described in this policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.

your_rights.title: 6. Your Rights
your_rights.content: In accordance with applicable data protection legislation (notably GDPR for users in Europe), you have the following rights:
details: Right of access to your data
Right to erasure (right to be forgotten)
your_rights.additional_info: To exercise these rights, you can contact us at the following address: jackpotproject2025@gmail.com

children_policy.title: 7. Application Not Intended for Children
children_policy.content: Our application does not target children under 13 years of age. If we discover that personal information has been collected from a child without parental consent, we will delete it immediately.

policy_changes.title: 8. Privacy Policy Changes
policy_changes.content: We reserve the right to modify this policy at any time. Any significant changes will be notified in the application or by email. We encourage you to regularly consult this page.

contact.title: 9. Contact
contact.content: For any questions regarding this privacy policy or your personal data, you can contact us at the following address: jackpotproject2025@gmail.com

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to Jack Pot! These terms of service govern your use of our smart pot and mobile application. By using our services, you agree to these terms.

service_description.title: Service Description
service_description.content: Jack Pot provides smart plant monitoring through our IoT-enabled pot and mobile application. Our service includes real-time plant health tracking, notifications, and analytics.

user_responsibilities.title: User Responsibilities
user_responsibilities.content: You are responsible for properly setting up and maintaining your Jack smart pot, providing accurate information, and using our services in compliance with applicable laws.

intellectual_property.title: Intellectual Property
intellectual_property.content: All content, features, and functionality of Jack Pot are owned by us and protected by copyright, trademark, and other intellectual property laws.

limitation_liability.title: Limitation of Liability
limitation_liability.content: Jack Pot is provided 'as is' without warranties. We are not liable for any damages arising from the use of our services, including plant health issues.

termination.title: Termination
termination.content: We may terminate or suspend your access to our services at any time for violations of these terms or for any other reason at our discretion.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.content: We may update these terms from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes through the app or email.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions about these terms, please contact us at legal@jackpot.com
